key_gap: On the rewrite proposal (16 dev-months Go rewrite vs incremental modernization), AI and human reached the same decision (reject rewrite, 6-week ETL-first modernization), but the AI never engaged the losing alternative at its strongest: it inherited the memo's dismissal of incremental work ('tried 3 times and failed') until a factual check, evaluated the alternatives as it listed them, never named the straw-man as a rhetorical move, never rebuilt the defender's case (340-fix re-derivation cost ~6-9 dev-months; ETL 1.8s of the 2.4s p99 is outside the rewrite scope; 1-of-7 Go staffing; attempts A/B cancelled by leadership, C never shipped), and left the 90%-untested-behavior risk unpriced and unaddressed in its decision. The human's decision provably survives the strongest version of the rejected alternative (survivor test: deepest objection answered by ETL-first sequencing + regression-harness-first refactoring); the AI's does not engage it, so its same outcome is not robust to the best defense.
learning_signal: Steel-manning converts 'the losing option was dismissed' into a testable claim: before scoring alternatives, (1) detect whether any alternative was dismissed with a label ('band-aid', 'tried and failed') rather than argued against, and set that dismissal aside as a straw-man; (2) rebuild the rejected alternative in the strongest form a skilled defender would give, from the evidence (not from the proposal's characterization); (3) run the survivor test — restate the decision so the rebuilt case, fully addressed, no longer defeats it. This is not symmetric praise-giving: it is a falsification pass on the decision itself, and it finds refutations that self-generated alternative listings miss (here: the rewrite fails its own success metric because the goal gap lives in the ETL, which the rewrite scope excludes).
suggested_improvement: Add a dialectical gate to the HOW stage, before selection: for the eventual losing alternative, require (1) a straw-man scan of the task's own framing (any pejorative label of an option is flagged and excluded as evidence); (2) a 'defender pass' — write the strongest evidence-grounded case for the rejected alternative as its proponent would, citing available evidence and costing its claims; (3) a survivor check in REVIEW — 'does my decision still stand against the rebuilt case, and which of its objections did I not answer?' — with the packet's risk section required to list any unanswered top-tier objection. Gate fails if the trace shows an alternative evaluated only as listed. This converts the agent's existing alternatives step from self-generated scoring into genuine dialectic.

key_gap: On the payment-incident rollback decision (23% error spike from hotfix r42; SLA penalty clock trips at 10 minutes of >15% errors), the pure steel-manning style rebuilt the deploy author's 'don't roll back' objection into a respectable case (act-on-incomplete-data, wrong-revert risk, in-flight writes), partially conceded it (added a verification gate), and consumed the penalty window: decision at 14:17, rollback at 14:19 vs. the 14:13 clock — ~6 penalty minutes ≈ $150K plus refund liability — and carried the objection into the final recommendation as an open risk ('LB hypothesis remains open'), granting an evidence-free position false legitimacy. The AI screened each claim against live evidence (LB green since r41, no data-loss mechanism in a durable-outbox diff, investigate-first satisfiable post-restore), falsified the objection, executed the reversible 2-minute rollback at ~14:08 with 0 penalty minutes, and still logged the objection and the canary-skipping process gap for follow-up.
learning_signal: Steel-manning's rebuild is a conditional courtesy, not a universal duty: the strength of the rebuild must be proportional to the evidence and stakes of the position. An evidence-free objection in a time-bound decision should be screened by burden of proof BEFORE being granted dialectical status — check each claim against available evidence and cost the time the rebuild consumes against the decision deadline. Absence of refutation is not doubt that must be honored: distinguish 'refuted' (LB metrics green) from 'unrefuted' (some other cause possible) and bound residual uncertainty by the reversibility and cost of the action, not by granting the objection co-equal status. False balance ('both positions have defensible cores') is itself a decision with a price, and this case priced it at ~$150K.
suggested_improvement: Add a pre-dialectic screening gate at the WHAT/WHY boundary: before any rebuild of an opposing position, require (1) an evidence-and-stakes triage — does the position carry any supporting evidence for its claims, and does the decision have a deadline or penalty? If no evidence and time-bounded, reject on burden of proof and log the objection as evidence-free (no rebuild); (2) a dialectic budget — when a rebuild is warranted, cost its steps and fail the gate if the deadline is at risk; (3) a legitimacy check on the final recommendation — no objection carried forward as an open risk unless it survived the evidence screen, and any process gap discovered (here: skipped canary) is logged as a follow-up item, not merged with the decision.
